name: Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya
permanent_address: 1 Tughlaq Road, New Delhi NCT of Delhi, 110011
countries_visited: Visited, (i) China, to study the development of industries, (ii) Israel, to study the new technology of agriculture, (iii) Europe (including U.K. and Germany), to study urban development and technology, (iv) Dubai (U.A.E.), to attend the food festival and to study the free trade system, (v) East African countries (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania and Rwanda), to study the forest life and culture, (vi) Part of President's Delegation for three countries -Ghana, Namibia and Cote d'lvoire, (vii) Part of Vice-President's delegation for South African countries - Algeria and Hungary, (viii) Italy, representing India at G20 Health Minister’s Meeting, (ix) Indian Pavilion at Expo 2020 in Dubai (U.A.E.), (x) France, to attend the Gavi Board Meeting and (xi) Geneva (Swizterland), as Stop TB Board Chairperson

positions.position: Member, Select Committee of Rajya Sabha on the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Bill, 2013; Member, Consultative Committee for the Ministry of Textiles and Member, Consultative Committee for the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Member, National Welfare Board for Seafarers Member, Committee on Chemicals and Fertilizers
Union Cabinet Minister of Labour and Employment; and Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports
Minister of Health and Family Welfare; and Minister of Chemicals and Fertilizers
Minister of State (Independent Charge) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways; and Minister of State in the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
Minister of State in the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways; Minister of State in the Ministry of Shipping; and Minister of State in the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
Member, Committee on Petroleum and Natural Gas
Chairman, Gujarat Agro Industries Corporation Ltd. (a Government Undertaking)

other_information: Senate Member, Bhavnagar University, 2003-2007; Member, State Executive Committee, A.B.V.P.; Secretary, Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha, Palitana, 1994-96; Taluka President, B.J.P., Palitana, 1998-2003; campaigned for girls' education by undertaking 123 km long “Kanya Kelavni Jyot Padyatra” which connected 45 educationally backward villages in Palitana taluka in 2005; organised 127 km long padyatra connecting 52 villages of Gariyadhar province in Palitana taluka, under the banner of “Beti Bachao, Beti Bhanavo, Vyasan Hatavo” in 2007; Deputy In-charge, Pradesh Sangathan Parv, 2009; as the Chairman, Gujarat Agro Industries Corporation Ltd., accorded importance to the farm mechanization, market for farmers and value addition; started biogas campaign to cater to the needs of domestic fuel and fertilizer; encouraged the farmers by organizing Mango festival and Kharek festival to enable them to get direct access to market for their produce and to remove mediators; In-charge, Pradesh Sangathan Parv, 2014; has given speech at the United Nations Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC), New York on the topic of "2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development"; Gujarat State General Secretary, B.J.P. since 2014
